example.en: Financial market analysts expressed fear that inflation could dampen consumer holiday spending.
example.zh: 金融市場分析師表達了擔憂，認為通貨膨脹可能會抑制消費者的節慶開銷。

words.mnemonic: 市場憂慮用語：for fear of (唯恐/以免)。

example.en: Our new digital marketing campaign aims to increase brand recognition among young entrepreneurs.
example.zh: 我們的新數位行銷推廣活動旨在提升年輕創業家對品牌的認知度。

words.mnemonic: 目標宗旨動詞句型：aim to do something (旨在做某事)。

example.en: The corporation allocated twenty percent of its promotional budget to national television advertisements.
example.zh: 該企業將其百分之二十的宣傳推廣預算提撥用於全國電視廣告。

words.mnemonic: 廣告媒體與飯店設施：television commercial (電視廣告)、flat-screen television (平面電視)。

example.en: Factory supervisors initiated a thorough safety audit following a serious machinery malfunction.
example.zh: 工廠主管在發生一起嚴重的機械故障後發起了一次徹底的安全審計。

words.mnemonic: 問題嚴重性形容詞：serious problem (嚴重問題)、take seriously (認真看待)。

example.en: The corporate sales division achieved its annual revenue target three weeks ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 企業銷售部門提前三週順利達成了其年度營收指標目標。

words.mnemonic: 多益商業核心搭配：meet a target (達成目標)、target market (目標市場)。

example.en: The senior consulting vacancy requires a master's degree in business administration or economics.
example.zh: 這項資深顧問職缺要求具備企管或經濟學碩士學位。

words.mnemonic: 履歷學歷與程度：bachelor's degree (學士學位)、to some degree (在某種程度上)。

example.en: The retailer decided to pull defective batches of electrical cords from store shelves immediately.
example.zh: 該零售商決定立即將有瑕疵批次的電源線從門市貨架上下架。

words.mnemonic: 商品下架與合作：pull from the market (從市場下架回收)、pull together (齊心協力)。

example.en: Due to unexpected manufacturing equipment repairs, the regional branch operated in the red this quarter.
example.zh: 由於無預警的製造設備維修支出，該區域分公司本季度陷入了赤字虧損狀態。

words.mnemonic: 多益財會超級成語考點：in the red (赤字/虧損)，反義詞為 in the black (獲利盈餘)！

example.en: The employee travel package allows staff members to bring their husband or wife at a discounted rate.
example.zh: 這套員工差旅套裝方案允許員工以折扣價攜同其丈夫或妻子同行。

words.mnemonic: 家庭福利政策：husband and wife (夫妻配偶)。

example.en: Authorized administrative personnel are granted full digital access to confidential client files.
example.zh: 獲得授權的行政人員獲准擁有查閱機密客戶檔案的完整數位存取權限。

words.mnemonic: 多益不可數名詞大考點：have access to (有權使用/進入)。

example.en: International market analysts tracked currency exchange movements over the preceding three quarters.
example.zh: 國際市場分析師追蹤記錄了前三個季度的貨幣匯率波動走勢。

words.mnemonic: 貨物流轉與價格走勢：cargo movement (貨物轉運)、price movement (價格變動)。

example.en: Our corporate customer service philosophy dictates that we treat every client with utmost respect.
example.zh: 我們的企業客戶服務哲學要求我們必須以最大的尊重來對待每一位客戶。

words.mnemonic: 待客之道動詞：treat someone with respect (以尊重對待某人)。

example.en: Quality assurance technicians performed comprehensive tests to identify the cause of the system error.
example.zh: 品保技術人員實施了全面檢測以查明系統錯誤的起因。

words.mnemonic: 問題分析核心字：identify problems (找出問題)、identify opportunities (辨認商機)。

example.en: The financial quarterly report showed a net operating loss due to unexpected legal expenditures.
example.zh: 財務季度報告顯示，由於意外的法務訴訟支出而出現了營業淨虧損。

words.mnemonic: 財報最常考名詞：profit and loss (損益)、at a loss (賠錢/不知所措)。

example.en: The corporate headquarters complex is outfitted with modern ergonomic workstations and meeting pods.
example.zh: 企業總部大樓園區配備了現代化的人體工學工作站與會議小間。

words.mnemonic: 先進設施描寫詞：modern equipment (現代化設備)、modern facilities (現代化設施)。

example.en: The engineering team worked well under pressure to meet the tight product launch deadline.
example.zh: 工程團隊在沉重壓力下表現優異，如期達成了緊湊的新產品發布截止時限。

words.mnemonic: 抗壓能力履歷用語：work well under pressure (抗壓性高/能在壓力下良好工作)。

example.en: A complimentary hotel shuttle bus provides convenient passenger transportation to the airport terminals.
example.zh: 飯店免費接駁巴士提供前往機場航廈的便利旅客接送交通服務。

words.mnemonic: 多益接駁專車核心詞：shuttle bus (接駁巴士)、bus stop (公車站)。

example.en: The enterprise travel lounge ensures that VIP corporate guests receive first-class treatment.
example.zh: 企業貴賓休息室確保每位企業貴賓旅客都能享受到第一流的尊爵待遇。

words.mnemonic: 待遇與廢棄物處理：equal treatment (平等待遇)、water treatment (水處理)。

example.en: The annual international commercial conference will be hosted in the hotel grand auditorium.
example.zh: 年度國際商務研討會大會將在飯店宏偉大禮堂隆重舉辦。

words.mnemonic: 多益最高頻場景：conference call (電話會議)、conference room (會議室)。
roots: -ence 名詞 → 把意見帶到一起

example.en: Please help yourself to complimentary coffee and bottled refreshments in the seminar lounge.
example.zh: 請在研討會休閒茶歇室隨意自取免費的咖啡與瓶裝茶點。

words.mnemonic: 社交招待常用客氣用語：help yourself to (請隨意自用)。

example.en: The office administrator placed a bulk order for recycled stationery and printer paper supplies.
example.zh: 辦公室管理員大宗訂購了一批環保再生文具與印表機用紙用品物資。

words.mnemonic: 多益最重要的採購詞：office supplies (辦公用品)、supply chain (供應鏈)。
roots: ply 填滿 → 從下補滿

example.en: The coastal resort village features private beach bungalows and championship golf facilities.
example.zh: 這座濱海休閒度假村設有專屬海灘獨棟小屋與錦標賽級高爾夫球場設施。

words.mnemonic: 度假勝地名詞：resort village (度假休閒村)。

example.en: Attending the industry networking summit is well worth the travel and registration investment.
example.zh: 出席這場產業人脈交流高峰會非常值得投入差旅與報名費的投資。

words.mnemonic: 值得做某事句型：well worth + V-ing (非常值得做...)。

example.en: Our personal care product line is formulated exclusively with certified organic natural ingredients.
example.zh: 我們的個人保養品系列完全採用經認證的有機天然原料配方調製而成。

words.mnemonic: 環保天然特色：natural ingredients (天然成分)、natural resources (天然資源)。

example.en: Orders placed before noon qualify for guaranteed overnight express courier delivery service.
example.zh: 中午前完成的訂單可享有保證隔夜抵達的快捷快遞遞送服務。

words.mnemonic: 多益物流大考點：express delivery (快遞配送)；動詞 express concern (表達關切)。
roots: press 壓 → 擠出來、表達

example.en: Preliminary market survey results clearly indicate growing consumer demand for electric cars.
example.zh: 初步市場調查結果清楚地顯示出消費者對電動車的需求持續增長。

words.mnemonic: 多益閱讀題幹最愛問：What does the notice indicate? (通知中指出了什麼)。

example.en: All employees must attend the meeting.
example.zh: 超過五十人參加了研討會。

words.mnemonic: attend a meeting。
roots: tend 伸展 → 向…伸出注意

example.en: The corporate family business was founded by two entrepreneurial brothers over fifty years ago.
example.zh: 這家企業家族企業是由兩位具創業家精神的兄弟在五十多年前聯手創立。

words.mnemonic: 家族企業背景名詞：family-owned business。

example.en: The executive committee approved a major capital investment in green energy technology.
example.zh: 執行委員會核准了一項針對綠色能源科技的重大資本投資案。

words.mnemonic: 金融投資名詞：return on investment (投資報酬率/ROI)、capital investment (資本投資)。
roots: vest 衣服 → 給資金穿上衣服

example.en: Our support center achieved the highest overall customer satisfaction score in company history.
example.zh: 我們的客服支援中心取得了公司創立以來整體客戶滿意度的最高評分。

words.mnemonic: 考核分數：satisfaction score (滿意度評分)、test score (測驗分數)。

example.en: The administrative committee worked tirelessly to organize the annual shareholder meeting.
example.zh: 行政籌備委員會不辭辛勞地工作，以籌辦年度股東大會。

words.mnemonic: 籌辦活動核心動詞：organize an event / organize a conference (籌辦活動/研討會)。

example.en: The regional sales manager will be away on an official business trip to Chicago next week.
example.zh: 區域銷售經理下週將前往芝加哥進行公務出差行程。

words.mnemonic: 多益職場最重要出差名詞：business trip (出差)、round-trip (來回)。

example.en: Our customer care representatives consistently go above and beyond to satisfy client needs.
example.zh: 我們的客戶關懷專員始終竭盡所能、全力以赴以超越預期地滿足客戶需求。

words.mnemonic: 多益超高頻客服片語：go above and beyond (全力以赴/超越期待)。

example.en: All luxury guest rooms are outfitted with premium soundproof windows to ensure a quiet sleep.
example.zh: 所有頂級豪華客房皆安裝有頂級隔音窗戶，以確保房客能享有寧靜安穩的睡眠。

words.mnemonic: 飯店住宿環境描寫字彙：get a good night's sleep (睡個好覺)。

example.en: The hotel seafood restaurant sources fresh fish daily from certified sustainable local fisheries.
example.zh: 該飯店海鮮餐廳每天向經認證的永續在地漁場採購新鮮魚貨。

words.mnemonic: 飯店宴飲海鮮菜單：fresh fish (鮮魚)、fish market (魚市場)。

example.en: Our corporate logistics team promises timely delivery of all express shipments nationwide.
example.zh: 我們的企業物流團隊承諾全國所有快捷包裹均能按時準點送達。

words.mnemonic: 企業承諾服務：promise to do (承諾做某事)、keep a promise (信守承諾)。
roots: mis 送 → 送出的承諾

example.en: Sales representatives distributed product sample kits to potential commercial clients at the expo.
example.zh: 業務代表在商展上向潛在企業客戶分發了產品樣品組。

words.mnemonic: 商機與人才評估：potential client / potential customer (潛在客戶)。

example.en: The factory installed rooftop solar panels to decrease commercial energy consumption expenses.
example.zh: 工廠安裝了屋頂太陽能板，以降低商業能源消耗開銷。

words.mnemonic: 環保永續大考點：energy consumption (能源消耗)、renewable energy (再生能源)。

example.en: Please contact our technical support hotline if you experience any trouble logging into the portal.
example.zh: 若您在登入系統入口網站時遇到任何麻煩困難，請撥打我們的技術支援專線。

words.mnemonic: 遇到困難高頻片語：have trouble doing (做...有困難)、troubleshoot (故障排除)。

example.en: Maintaining harmonious public relations is vital for sustaining long-term investor confidence.
example.zh: 維護融洽的公共關係對於維繫投資人的長期信心至關重要。

words.mnemonic: 公關部專有名詞：public relations (PR, 公關)、customer relations (客戶關係)。

example.en: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
example.zh: 這間大宴會廳最多可容納兩百位賓客同時入座。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 想像房間把客人安排進去。

example.en: Please make sure the report is accurate.
example.zh: 編制財務報表時務必提供精準無誤的數據。

reviewWords.mnemonic: accurate = correct。

example.zh: 請於抵達診所前先以電話完成看診預約。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常和 make 或 confirm 搭配。

example.en: The manager is available after lunch.
example.zh: 會議室目前空著可使用。

reviewWords.mnemonic: available = ready to be used。

example.en: Employees receive health benefits.
example.zh: 新政策為全體員工帶來好處。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 想成工作帶來的好處。

example.en: Please confirm your reservation by email.
example.zh: 請致電飯店以確認您的訂房資料。

reviewWords.mnemonic: confirm = make sure。

example.en: The store is convenient for commuters.
example.zh: 線上預辦登機服務為商務差旅客戶提供了極大便利。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 和 convenience 都與方便有關。
roots: ven 來 → 湊在一起正好

example.en: Contact the sales department for details.
example.zh: 行銷部門位在三樓。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 公司裡分工的部門。

example.en: Customers receive a ten percent discount.
example.zh: 凡大量訂購辦公文具者均可享有批量折扣。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 讓價格往下掉。

example.en: Please attach the document to your email.
example.zh: 請於簽署前仔細閱讀文件。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 文件可以被 attach。
roots: -ument 名詞 → 用來教導／佐證的文件

example.en: The new policy is effective immediately.
example.zh: 新的考勤規範將於下個月初正式生效。

reviewWords.mnemonic: effective = works well。

example.en: The office purchased new equipment.
example.zh: 工廠安裝了最先進的檢驗設備。

reviewWords.mnemonic: equipment 通常不可數。

example.en: The repair estimate is two hundred dollars.

roots: pens 秤、花費 → 付出去

example.en: The sports facility opens at six.
example.zh: 工廠設施配備了最先進的安全系統。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 提供服務的場所。

example.zh: 這列機場接駁專車尖峰時段每十分鐘密集發車。

reviewWords.mnemonic: frequent 的副詞形式。

example.en: She handles customer complaints professionally.
example.zh: 客服團隊妥善處理了所有客訴案件。

reviewWords.mnemonic: handle a problem = 處理問題。

reviewWords.mnemonic: immediately = right away。

example.zh: 我們希望提升客戶滿意度。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常接能力或品質。

example.zh: 銷售額增長了百分之十五。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 可以是名詞或動詞。

example.en: We will inform you of the decision.
example.zh: 我們遺憾地通知您班機將延誤啟程。

reviewWords.mnemonic: inform someone of something。
roots: form 形成 → 使心中成形、告知

example.en: The label lists every ingredient.
example.zh: 這家餐廳堅持只選用新鮮在地的有機食材烹調料理。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 食品標籤常見單字。

example.zh: 本週末因進行空調系統例行維護，辦公大樓將暫停開放。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常和 building 或 equipment 搭配。

example.en: Ask the manager for assistance.
example.zh: 專案經理審核了時程表。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 管理 team 或 department。

example.en: This method saves time and money.
example.zh: 這是一種更有效率的付款方式。

reviewWords.mnemonic: method = way of doing something。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 可表示注意到或公告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 比 get 更正式。

example.zh: 只有受過訓練的技術員才能操作這台機器。

reviewWords.mnemonic: operate a machine or company。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 後面接名詞或動名詞。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 評價環境或待人親切常用詞：have a nice stay (祝您住宿愉快)。

example.zh: 發票上明確載明了應付總金額，包含適用的運費與處理費。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 修飾不可數名詞或款項：amount of money (金額)、total amount (總額)。

example.en: High-resolution pictures of our latest product line are available in the online press kit.
example.zh: 我們最新產品線的高解析度照片已備置於線上媒體新聞發布資料包中。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 行銷圖片與總體情勢：take a picture (拍照)、the big picture (整體大局)。

example.zh: 這家體育用品公司推出了一場鎖定活躍青少年族群的運動服飾行銷宣傳。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 服飾銷售與公眾慈善常見客群名詞。

example.en: I am writing to inquire about your company's latest policy with regard to remote work arrangements.

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益公文兩大王牌：with regard to (關於/就...而言)、Best regards (祝好/信末敬上)。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 促銷呼籲行動常客：call us today (今天就致電我們)。

example.en: Standard corporate office hours are from nine in the morning until five in the evening.
example.zh: 標準企業辦公營業時間為上午九點至下午五點。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 營業與辦公時間多益必考：business hours / office hours (營業/辦公時間)。

example.en: Full-time university students are eligible for a twenty percent discount on exhibition passes.
example.zh: 全職大學生可享有展覽入場證八折優惠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 學生票價促銷與實習生招募考點：student discount (學生優惠)。

example.en: Local retailers face intense competition from multinational online e-commerce platforms.
example.zh: 在地零售商正面臨來自跨國線上電商平台的激烈競爭。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益職場商業挑戰動詞：face challenges / face competition (面臨挑戰/競爭)。

example.en: We hope to conclude the contract negotiations with the overseas supplier by Friday.
example.zh: 我們期盼能在週五之前敲定與海外供應商的合約談判。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務書信期許句型：We hope that... / hope to do something。

example.en: The design team presented an innovative idea for the eco-friendly product packaging.
example.zh: 設計團隊針對環保產品包裝提出了一個創新的構想。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 腦力激盪常用詞：innovative idea (創新點子)。

example.en: Implementing digital automation helped our factory reduce overall operating costs by ten percent.
example.zh: 導入數位自動化幫助我們的工廠將整體營運成本降低了百分之十。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業財務高頻詞：operating costs (營運成本)、at all costs (不惜一切代價)。

example.en: The upgraded machinery consumes significantly less electricity than earlier models.
example.zh: 這台升級後的機具耗電量明顯低於早期的機種。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 修飾不可數名詞：less money / less time；片語 no less than (不少於)。

example.en: Please confirm whether the executive conference room has been reserved for our client briefing.
example.zh: 請確認高階會議室是否已被預訂作為我們的大客簡報之用。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店與會議必考：conference room (會議室)、room service (客房服務)。

example.en: The early registration promotional discount remains valid until midnight this coming Friday.
example.zh: 早鳥報名促銷優惠將持續有效，直到本週五午夜為止。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益截止日期關鍵介系詞：valid until (有效期限至...)、until further notice (直到另行通知)。

example.en: The main reason for the flight cancellation was heavy snowfall across the regional airport.
example.zh: 航班取消的主要原因是區域機場普降大雪。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 解釋狀況必用片語：the reason for (做...的原因)。

example.en: All job applicants are requested to complete the online background verification form.
example.zh: 所有應徵者皆須填妥線上背景查核表格。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 行政事務極高頻詞：application form (申請表)、fill out a form (填表)。

example.en: Our marketing division plans to spend twenty percent of its budget on social media advertisements.
example.zh: 我們的行銷部門計劃將百分之二十的預算花費在社群媒體廣告上。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 預算配置與時間管理動詞：spend money on (在...上花錢)。

example.en: Mr. Chen was recently appointed as the new head of the corporate legal department.
example.zh: 陳先生最近獲任命為企業法務部門的新任主管。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 職銜稱謂常客：department head (部門主管)、headquarters (總部)。

example.en: Corporate business travelers can reserve a rental car directly through our travel agency partner.
example.zh: 企業商務旅客可以直接透過我們的合作旅行社預訂租賃車輛。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 差旅租車必備字：rental car (租賃車)、car rental agency (租車公司)。

example.en: New staff members will learn company compliance rules during their first week of orientation.
example.zh: 新進員工將在到職培訓的第一週學習公司的法規遵從守則。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益雙重用法：既表示「學習技巧」，也常在書信中表示「得知消息」(learn that)。
